Root.description:
Groups all parts of the preview card.
Doesn't render its own HTML element.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the preview card is initially open. To render a controlled preview card, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the preview card is currently open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the preview card is opened or closed.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A callback that receives the imperative actions. It's called once, when the component is set up (like a `ref` callback). `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the preview card after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the preview card completes closing on its own.
Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.`close`: Closes the preview card imperatively when called.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the preview card is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open preview card.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the preview card with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the card's open state.
Can be created with the PreviewCard.createHandle() method.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the preview card is opened or closed.

props.name: triggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the preview card is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled preview card.
There's no need to specify this prop when the preview card is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: children
props.description:
The content of the preview card.
This can be a regular Solid JSX or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.
A render function is called once with `{ payload }`, where `payload` is an accessor of the active trigger's payload, so it can be destructured.

additionalTypes.name: Root.Actions
additionalTypes.source: type PreviewCardRootActions = { unmount: () => void; close: () => void };

additionalTypes.name: Root.ChangeEventDetails

Positioner.description:
Positions the popup against the trigger.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: disableAnchorTracking
props.description: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.

props.name: align
props.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description:
Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.`data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.`data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.`data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: side
props.description:
Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
May automatically change to avoid collisions.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description:
Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment. The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties: `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.`data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.`data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.`data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

props.name: arrowPadding
props.description: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.

props.name: anchor
props.type: Element | VirtualElement | (() => Element | VirtualElement | null) | null
props.description:
An element to position the popup against.
By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description:
Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side
(`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`).`'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within
the clipping boundary so it stays visible.`'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows.`'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the
alignment axis to fit.`'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the
preferred axis cannot fit: `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first
(`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR).`'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first
(`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR).`'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`.
If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.

props.name: collisionBoundary
props.description: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.

props.name: sticky
props.description:
Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after
the anchor element was scrolled out of view.

props.name: positionMethod
props.description: Determines which CSS `position` property to use.

Viewport.description:
A viewport for displaying content transitions.
This component is only required if one popup can be opened by multiple triggers, its content
changes based on the trigger, and switching between them is animated.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to render inside the transition container.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-activation-direction
dataAttributes.description:
Indicates the direction from which the popup was activated.
This can be used to create directional animations based on how the popup was triggered.
Contains space-separated values for both horizontal and vertical axes.

dataAttributes.name: data-current
dataAttributes.description: Applied to the direct child of the viewport when no transitions are present or the new content when it's entering.

dataAttributes.name: data-instant
dataAttributes.description: Present if animations should be instant.

dataAttributes.name: data-previous
dataAttributes.description: Applied to the direct child of the viewport that contains the exiting content when transitions are present.

dataAttributes.name: data-transitioning
dataAttributes.description: Indicates that the viewport is currently transitioning between old and new content.

cssVariables.name: --popup-height
cssVariables.description:
The height of the parent popup.
This variable is placed on the 'previous' container and stores the height of the popup when the previous content was rendered.
It can be used to freeze the dimensions of the popup when animating between different content.

cssVariables.name: --popup-width
cssVariables.description:
The width of the parent popup.
This variable is placed on the 'previous' container and stores the width of the popup when the previous content was rendered.
It can be used to freeze the dimensions of the popup when animating between different content.

additionalTypes.name: Viewport.State

createHandle.description: Creates a new handle to connect a PreviewCard.Root with detached PreviewCard.Trigger components.

Handle.description:
Controls a PreviewCard imperatively and associates detached `PreviewCard.Trigger` components with
a `PreviewCard.Root`. Create one with `PreviewCard.createHandle()` and pass it to the `handle`
prop of the root and of any triggers rendered outside of it.

The imperative methods take effect only while a root using this handle is mounted; calls made
before a root attaches (or after it unmounts) are ignored.






Opens the preview card and associates it with the trigger with the given id.

This method should only be called in an event handler or an effect (not during rendering).



Closes the preview card.

This method should only be called in an event handler or an effect (not during rendering).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the preview card is currently open. Returns false while no root is attached to the handle.
